Players Committee card image of [[I Am Your Father (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. [Death Star 2] Vader is deploy = 6. Once per turn, may deploy Vader's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or lose 1 Force to deploy it from Lost Pile). Whenever a lightsaber swung by Vader 'hits' a character, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to NOOOOOOOOOOOO! [Immune to Alter.]”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/iamyourfather.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
